title: Introduction to Expo APIs
overview: Expo APIs provide ready-to-use libraries that allow applications to access device features without writing native code.

example.title: Expo API Concept
example.content:
React Native App
 ↓
Expo API
 ↓
Device Feature

title: Camera API
overview: Expo Camera API allows applications to access the device camera and capture photos or videos.

title: Location API
overview: Expo Location API provides access to device location services and GPS information.

title: File System API
overview: Expo File System API allows applications to read, write, and manage files on the device.

title: Sharing API
overview: Expo Sharing API allows users to share files or content with other applications installed on the device.

title: Contacts API
overview: Expo Contacts API allows applications to access and manage contact information with user permission.

title: Clipboard API
overview: Expo Clipboard API allows applications to copy and read text from the device clipboard.

title: Sensors API
overview: Expo Sensors API provides access to device hardware sensors like accelerometer and gyroscope.

title: Permissions Handling
overview: Expo APIs often require permissions before accessing device features. Applications should request and handle permissions properly.

example.title: Permission Flow
example.content:
Request Permission
 ↓
User Allows
 ↓
Access Device Feature

title: Topic Summary
overview: You learned about important Expo APIs including camera, location, files, sharing, contacts, sensors, and permissions.
